change_summary: The journal editors issued an expression of concern about this paper, saying they have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in it. They say the matter is being looked into and readers will be updated later. The notice does not say which data are affected. The paper's abstract reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test (Figure 3).
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, supporting a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour. recommendation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, in support of a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says your own proposal builds on this finding.
